newsitem.title: UK: LME copper over $1,900, aluminium straddles $1,400.
newsitem.headline: LME copper over $1,900, aluminium straddles $1,400.

text.p: It was a day for big numbers on the London Metal Exchange (LME) on Tuesday as copper broke through psychological resistance at $1,900 a tonne and aluminium straddled the key $1,400 level.
But in spite of copper's strong performance, the reaction on other base metal markets was fairly muted.
Three month copper futures rose $37 to $1,920 a tonne by the end of the afternoon kerb close, boosted by a larger-than-expected fall in warehouse stocks of 8,825 tonnes.
Cash buying emerged during the morning session and buy stops above $1,900 were triggered, leading to short-covering.
